about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Chrissy Houlahan

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2102, MAJOR RICHARD STAR ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2102, MAJOR RICHARD STAR ACT
sentences: I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on the Major Richard Star Act and to finally deliver the support that our Nation's wounded veterans deserve.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECRETARY HEGSETH IMPEACHMENT
statements.title: SECRETARY HEGSETH IMPEACHMENT
sentences: I rise today in support of the Articles of Impeachment that have been brought against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth by my colleague, Congressman Thomas Massie, because since the day he was nominated, I have been clear, Secretary Hegseth is not qualified for this job.
Secretary Hegseth wants to poison this impeachment process with the very same partisan hostility that he has injected into our military, but we will not allow him to do so.

We will keep up this fight because he earned it and because it is the right thing for our troops, it is the right thing for our military families, and it is the right thing for our country. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: APPLICATION OF LEAVE PROVISIONS FOR MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES TO MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HEALTH SERVICE
statements.title: APPLICATION OF LEAVE PROVISIONS FOR MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES TO MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HEALTH SERVICE
sentences: I know something about that choice because, when I served in the Air Force, there was a 6-month waiting list for on-base childcare, but I only had 6 weeks of personal leave after the birth of my child.
My own experience is just one reason why I was so proud to help secure 12 weeks of paid parental leave in the past for our military servicemembers in the fiscal year 2021 NDAA.
However, when they become parents, right now, we don't give them the same parental leave benefits that we provide their counterparts in the armed services.
Madam Speaker, I rise today in support of my bipartisan and bicameral U.S. Public Health Service parity act, H.R. 2846.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: It doesn't strengthen the religious liberty.
That is, in fact, a profound departure from how our military has always understood religious liberty.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
statements.title: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
sentences: I can support voter ID requirements, which I do, and I can support banning Members of Congress from trading stocks, which I do, and I am in compliance.
This bill's stock-trading provisions do not go nearly far enough.

Instead, also in this bill, Republicans are attaching new barriers for Americans to vote by mail, requiring photocopies of a very narrow set of acceptable IDs, more narrow than those required in the State of Texas.
If Republicans really wanted to ban Member stock trading, then bring us a really clean bill, and I will vote for it.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to reject this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: These improvements to servicemembers' paychecks should provide welcome relief to military families who are still struggling with ever-increasing gas and food prices caused by the ill-conceived and poorly executed tariffs and the current war with Iran.

The bill expands ongoing efforts to improve access to safe and quality childcare by including au pairs in the Child Care in Your Home pilot program and establishing a student internship program to improve recruitment and staffing of military child development centers.

It provides a process by which military families executing a permanent change of station will receive timely and relevant relocation assistance and available childcare and food access services in advance of that military duty station move.

Finally, the bill requires the Department to issue regulations banning the Department of Defense personnel from insider trading on prediction markets, a necessary and crucial step in safeguarding our national security.

We brought this bill to the floor in a bipartisan fashion, and I urge my colleagues to reject poison pill riders that will destabilize this important work and to not insert bipartisan politics over the well- being of our servicemembers.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOMENT OF SILENCE TO HONOR THE LIFE AND SERVICE OF CORPORAL TIMOTHY O'CONNOR, JR.
statements.title: MOMENT OF SILENCE TO HONOR THE LIFE AND SERVICE OF CORPORAL TIMOTHY O'CONNOR, JR.
sentences: Corporal O'Connor wore the uniform of the Pennsylvania State Police for 15 years, serving the people of our Commonwealth.
We hold his wife, Casey, their young daughter, and the entire Pennsylvania State Police family in our hearts.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SMALL BUSINESS INNOVATION AND ECONOMIC SECURITY ACT
statements.title: SMALL BUSINESS INNOVATION AND ECONOMIC SECURITY ACT
sentences: I urge all of my colleagues to vote ``yes'' for the Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
statements.title: REMOVAL OF THE USE OF UNITED STATES FORCES FOR HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST VENEZUELA
sentences: The U.S. military is being used against Venezuela without congressional authorization, without transparency, and in ways that appear only designed to benefit the very powerful amongst us--the oil companies--and not the Venezuelan people, and certainly not our American people to whom we are obligated to represent.

The American people don't want their sons or their daughters sent into harm's way for their missions to Venezuela or to Greenland or to anywhere else that are undertaken just to enrich corporations and the most wealthy amongst us and cronies of the President's, and to do nothing in the process to lower the cost of living, to help families afford housing or healthcare, or to secure a future for our children.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides of this aisle to vote ``yes,'' to do our jobs so that we may reaffirm our authority and rein in reckless action.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: It is divisive, shameful, and irresponsible for us to ask our soldiers to act as local police officers, a role that undermines our readiness for actual conflicts.
Mr. Chair, I rise in strong opposition to this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: H.R. 3838 expands ongoing efforts to improve the access to safe and quality childcare by extending the Childcare in Your Home pilot program through 2029.
Additionally, the bill will require the Department to conduct annual reviews of childcare fee assistance rates.
Madam Chair, we support readiness and recruitment.

I urge my colleagues to reject poison pill policy riders that will be added to this bill that could destabilize this very important work and to not put partisan politics above the well-being of our servicemembers.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WOMEN IN THE MILITARY
statements.title: WOMEN IN THE MILITARY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today as a veteran of the United States Air Force on this national Women Veterans Day to tell Secretary Hegseth and President Trump that women who raise their hand and swear an oath to protect and defend this Nation are not going anywhere and we will not be silent.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MATHEMATICAL AND STATISTICAL MODELING EDUCATION ACT
statements.title: MATHEMATICAL AND STATISTICAL MODELING EDUCATION ACT
sentences: I will repeat again that this is without any additional cost.
I will also repeat again that this is a bipartisan piece of legislation that will provide our young people with the skills they need to succeed in our marketplace.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues on both sides to support this commonsense, bipartisan measure to strengthen our national security and our economy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROCUREMENT AND PLACEMENT OF STATUE OF BENJAMIN FRANKLIN IN THE UNITED STATES CAPITOL
statements.title: PROCUREMENT AND PLACEMENT OF STATUE OF BENJAMIN FRANKLIN IN THE UNITED STATES CAPITOL
sentences: The installation of this statue in the Capitol Building will not only be an apt celebration for such an important figure in our history, but it is something that I will urge my colleagues to make sure that we vote in favor of today, so we can start that clock ticking.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THREE-YEAR ANNIVERSARY OF RUSSIA'S BRUTAL ATTACK ON UKRAINE
statements.title: THREE-YEAR ANNIVERSARY OF RUSSIA'S BRUTAL ATTACK ON UKRAINE
sentences: It is the anniversary of Russia's brutal attack on Ukraine.
Three years ago, Russia started this war by invading Ukraine, not the other way around.
It is Putin who wants to take Ukraine's resource-rich land.
It is Putin who wants to strip its people of their rights and their freedoms, and it is Putin who wants to destroy another European democracy.
It is Putin who is a cancer on the world, a liar, a torturer, a murderer, and a war criminal.

It is appalling to see our President of these United States, expected to be a reliable standard-bearer of democracy, align himself and as a result ourselves so closely with our adversaries, even organizing a sit-down to determine the fate of Ukraine without Ukraine at the table, and without the input of our European allies at all.
It will instead be a Russian power grab and an appeasement of war criminal Putin facilitated by the United States, an illegitimate peace.

As President Trump and his administration publicly trash our allies, undermine the strength of NATO, and decimate our international aid programs, our adversaries are greedily and happily waiting to fill the gaps that this administration is deliberately creating.

On Monday, the United States joined Russia, North Korea, Belarus, Sudan, and Hungary--I will name them again: Russia, North Korea, Belarus, Sudan, and Hungary--a group of countries I never would like us to be associated with, in voting against the United Nations resolution condemning Russian aggression and demanding the immediate withdrawal of Putin's forces from Ukraine.
To quote my Republican colleague and dear friend, Congressman Don Bacon: The Trump administration royally screwed up on Ukraine.
Indeed, on April 20 of last year, 101 Republicans voted to support Ukraine.
I hope that the other 100 Members who supported aid to Ukraine in April will be as brave as Representative Bacon and speak out against this administration's ridiculous and dangerous actions.
President Trump's disavowal of Ukraine and his cozying up to dictators puts us here in the United States at risk as well.
America's global leadership also helps to keep Americans safe, too.
President Trump turning his back on Ukraine isolates us and undermines our strength, the strength of international institutions, and the security networks that work, like NATO.
This encourages NATO allies to question our own alliance and allegiance.

With President Trump actually allying himself with China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea, these countries now seemingly have America's explicit backing to spread their influence, and in some cases to spread their force, like we have seen in Ukraine.
We can't turn our back on Ukraine and the world, and we cannot expect that the consequences of that decision will not reach our shores.

If our Nation turns its back on Ukraine, we heard about what comes next: Our ally Taiwan left in greater jeopardy to a Chinese invasion; our allies elsewhere left looking for security and other trading opportunities; and worst of all, our enemies worldwide left emboldened by Trump's isolationist actions.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ADDRESSING THE HACK OF U.S. TREASURY PAYMENT SYSTEMS
statements.title: ADDRESSING THE HACK OF U.S. TREASURY PAYMENT SYSTEMS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Taxpayer Data Protection Act, but before then, I will hold this piece of paper up for just a little while because it is my anticipation that before I finish speaking, the internet will have transcribed this piece of paper and the data that is in it.
Perhaps he will have access to your Social Security number or perhaps your health information.
It looks like supporting this bill that is on the floor, the Taxpayer Data Protection Act.
